ordered_diagnoses: Osteomyelitis of the femur or pelvis

s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute left leg pain and weakness with systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Increasing left leg pain and weakness
Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement
key_facts: One week of increasing left leg pain and weakness
Anorexia and 12% body-weight loss over six months
Low blood pressure responsive to IV fluids
Neurologic examination showed 4/5 strength in left hip and knee flexors and extensors
Worsening left hip pain despite analgesia
Decline in strength to 2/5 at the hip and 3/5 at the knee
Small anterior joint effusion on left hip ultrasound
No evidence of malignancy on MRI of the hip and isotope bone scan
